words.defn_en: speaking or representing the truth:

sentences.en: The journalist was praised for her ______ reporting on the crisis.
sentences.zh: 這位記者因她對這場危機真實可靠的報導而受到讚揚。

sentences.en: Jurors found the witness to be ______ and consistent.
sentences.zh: 陪審團認為這位證人誠實可信且前後一致。

words.defn_en: relating to or expressed in words, especially spoken:

sentences.en: They reached a ______ agreement before signing the contract.
sentences.zh: 他們在簽署合約之前先達成了口頭協議。

sentences.en: The coach gave a stern ______ warning to the disruptive player.
sentences.zh: 這位教練對這位搗亂的球員給予了嚴厲的口頭警告。

words.defn_en: in exactly the same words; word for word:

sentences.en: She recited the poem ______ from memory.
sentences.zh: 她一字不差地憑記憶背誦了這首詩。

sentences.en: The court requested a ______ transcript of the entire hearing.
sentences.zh: 法院要求提供這場聽證會逐字的完整紀錄。

words.defn_en: excessive or unnecessary use of words:
words.root_note: verbier (to chatter), from Old French, from Latin verbum (word)

sentences.en: The report was buried under layers of unnecessary ______ .
sentences.zh: 這份報告被層層不必要的冗詞贅語所淹沒。

sentences.en: He cut the ______ and got straight to the point.
sentences.zh: 他刪去了那些冗詞贅語,直接切入重點。

words.defn_en: to repeat words or phrases meaninglessly, often as a symptom of mental disturbance:
words.root_note: verbigerare, from Latin verbum (word) + gerere (to carry on)

sentences.en: The patient would ______ the same phrase for hours during an episode.
sentences.zh: 這名病患在發病期間會連續數小時無意義地重複同一句話。

sentences.en: Psychiatrists noted his tendency to ______ under extreme stress.
sentences.zh: 精神科醫生注意到他在極度壓力下有無意義重複言語的傾向。

words.defn_en: the meaningless repetition of words or phrases, often as a symptom of mental illness:
words.root_note: verbigerare, from Latin verbum (word) + gerere (to carry on)

sentences.en: The doctor documented episodes of ______ in the patient's chart.
sentences.zh: 這位醫生在病患的病歷上記錄了言語重複症的發作情形。

sentences.en: Researchers study ______ as one symptom among several psychiatric conditions.
sentences.zh: 研究人員將言語重複症視為好幾種精神疾病中的一項症狀來研究。

words.defn_en: a person who meaninglessly repeats words or phrases (rare word):
words.root_note: verbigerare, from Latin verbum (word) + gerere (to carry on)

sentences.en: The rare clinical term ______ describes someone prone to repetitive, meaningless speech.
sentences.zh: 這個罕見的臨床詞彙「verbigerator」形容一個容易出現重複、無意義言語的人。

sentences.en: Case studies occasionally reference the ______ as an extreme example of speech disturbance.
sentences.zh: 個案研究偶爾會將言語重複者作為言語障礙極端案例來引用。

words.defn_en: talkative:

sentences.en: The professor's ______ lecture left many students confused and bored.
sentences.zh: 教授囉嗦冗長的講課讓許多學生感到困惑又乏味。

sentences.en: Please edit this report; it is far too ______ for a short summary.
sentences.zh: 請修改這份報告,對於一份簡短的摘要來說太過冗長囉嗦了。

words.defn_en: the use of more words than needed; wordiness:
words.root_note: verbositas, from Latin verbosus (wordy), from verbum (word)

sentences.en: The editor trimmed the essay's ______ to make it more readable.
sentences.zh: 這位編輯刪減了這篇文章的冗長之處,讓它更易於閱讀。

sentences.en: His speeches were known for their ______ and lack of clear direction.
sentences.zh: 他的演說以冗長囉唆且缺乏明確方向而聞名。

words.defn_en: forbidden, especially by an authority:

sentences.en: Loud music after 10 p.m. was strictly ______ in the apartment building.
sentences.zh: 在這棟公寓大樓裡,晚上十點後播放大聲音樂是嚴格禁止的。

sentences.en: Discussing salaries was considered ______ in that workplace culture.
sentences.zh: 在那種職場文化中,討論薪資被視為一種禁忌。

words.defn_en: green in tint or color:

sentences.en: The hillside was covered in ______ pastures after the spring rains.
sentences.zh: 春雨過後,這片山坡覆蓋著一片翠綠的牧草地。

sentences.en: Visitors marveled at the ______ rice terraces stretching across the valley.
sentences.zh: 遊客們對這片延伸至整座山谷的翠綠梯田讚嘆不已。

words.defn_en: lush green vegetation:
words.root_note: verdure, from Old French, from Latin viridis (green)

sentences.en: The valley was covered in rich ______ after the spring rains.
sentences.zh: 這片山谷在春雨過後覆蓋著一片濃郁的翠綠。

sentences.en: Hikers admired the dense ______ of the tropical rainforest.
sentences.zh: 健行者們讚嘆這片熱帶雨林濃密的綠意。

words.defn_en: the utmost or most complete (superlative of very, archaic):
words.defn_zh: 最真實的;十足的(古語,very的最高級)
words.root_note: very, from Old French verai (true), from Latin verus + -est

sentences.en: He was accused of the ______ nonsense for suggesting such an idea.
sentences.zh: 他因提出這樣的想法而被指責是十足的荒謬。

sentences.en: She showed the ______ kindness in caring for the stray animals.
sentences.zh: 她在照顧這些流浪動物時展現出最真摯的善意。

words.defn_en: in truth; certainly (archaic):
words.root_note: verray (true), from Old French verai, from Latin verus

sentences.en: The old text declared, " ______ , this is a day of reckoning."
sentences.zh: 這篇古文宣告道:「確實,這是一個清算的日子。」

sentences.en: She ______ believed her cause was just, whatever the cost.
sentences.zh: 無論代價為何,她都真心相信自己的理念是正義的。

words.defn_en: having the appearance of being true or real:

sentences.en: The novel's ______ dialogue made the characters feel authentic.
sentences.zh: 這本小說貌似真實的對話讓這些角色顯得栩栩如生。

sentences.en: Special effects made the film's disaster scenes remarkably ______ .
sentences.zh: 特效讓這部電影的災難場景顯得異常逼真。

words.defn_en: a true principle or belief, especially one of enduring importance:

sentences.en: The philosopher explored eternal ______ ies about human nature.
sentences.zh: 這位哲學家探討了關於人性永恆不變的真理。

sentences.en: She questioned the ______ of the claims made in the advertisement.
sentences.zh: 她對這則廣告中所做的宣稱之真實性提出了質疑。

words.defn_en: shaped like a worm:

sentences.en: The ______ appendix is a small pouch attached to the large intestine.
sentences.zh: 這條蠕蟲狀的闌尾是附著在大腸上的一個小囊袋。

sentences.en: Scientists examined the ______ larvae under a microscope.
sentences.zh: 科學家在顯微鏡下檢視了這些蠕蟲狀的幼蟲。

words.defn_en: any of various small animals or insects that are pests:

sentences.en: The old warehouse had a serious ______ problem, with rats everywhere.
sentences.zh: 這座老舊倉庫有嚴重的害蟲問題,到處都是老鼠。

sentences.en: Farmers set traps to control the ______ threatening their crops.
sentences.zh: 農民設置陷阱,以控制威脅作物的害蟲害獸。

words.defn_en: the everyday language spoken by ordinary people, as opposed to formal language:
words.root_note: vernaculus (native, domestic), from Latin verna (a home-born slave)

sentences.en: The author wrote the novel in the local ______ to capture authentic dialogue.
sentences.zh: 這位作者以當地的白話文寫作這本小說,以捕捉真實的對話。

sentences.en: Medieval scholars eventually began writing in the ______ rather than Latin.
sentences.zh: 中世紀的學者最終開始以方言而非拉丁文寫作。

words.defn_en: relating to spring; fresh and youthful:

sentences.en: The ______ equinox marks the official start of spring.
sentences.zh: 春分標誌著春天正式的開始。

sentences.en: A ______ freshness filled the garden after months of winter.
sentences.zh: 經過數月的冬天,一股春天般的清新氣息瀰漫在這座花園中。

words.defn_en: energy and enthusiasm, especially in artistic or creative endeavors:
words.root_note: verve (vigor), from Old French, from Latin verba (words)

sentences.en: She performed the aria with tremendous ______ and emotion.
sentences.zh: 她以極大的活力與情感演唱了這首詠嘆調。

sentences.en: His paintings are known for their bold color and youthful ______ .
sentences.zh: 他的畫作以大膽的色彩與青春洋溢的活力聞名。

words.defn_en: a religious evening service, especially in Christian traditions:

sentences.en: Monks gathered in the chapel each evening for ______ .
sentences.zh: 修士們每天傍晚都會聚集在這座禮拜堂進行晚禱。

sentences.en: The bells rang out to announce the start of ______ .
sentences.zh: 鐘聲響起,宣告晚禱即將開始。

words.defn_en: relating to or occurring in the evening:

sentences.en: The garden was designed to showcase ______ flowers that bloom at dusk.
sentences.zh: 這座花園的設計旨在展示在黃昏時分綻放的傍晚花卉。

sentences.en: Certain bat species are known for their ______ hunting habits.
sentences.zh: 某些蝙蝠物種以牠們在傍晚時分的狩獵習性聞名。

words.defn_en: evidence, trace:

sentences.en: A few crumbling walls were the only ______ of the ancient city.
sentences.zh: 幾面搖搖欲墜的殘牆是這座古城僅存的遺跡。

sentences.en: Not a single ______ of the old amusement park remained.
sentences.zh: 這座舊遊樂園沒有留下任何一絲痕跡。

words.defn_en: remaining as a trace of something that once existed; underdeveloped:

sentences.en: The whale's ______ leg bones are remnants of its land-dwelling ancestors.
sentences.zh: 這隻鯨魚殘留的腿骨是牠陸生祖先留下的遺跡。

sentences.en: The old law remained ______ , rarely enforced but never repealed.
sentences.zh: 這條舊法律形同殘留的遺跡,極少被執行卻也從未被廢除。

words.defn_en: a person with long experience, especially in the military:

sentences.en: The parade honored ______ s from every branch of the armed forces.
sentences.zh: 這場遊行向來自各個軍種的退伍老兵致敬。

sentences.en: As a ______ teacher, she mentored several new hires each year.
sentences.zh: 身為一位資深教師,她每年都會指導好幾位新進教師。

words.defn_en: to annoy or worry someone; to cause distress:

sentences.en: The constant noise began to ______ the students trying to concentrate.
sentences.zh: 不斷的噪音開始讓試圖專心的學生們感到煩躁。

sentences.en: It continues to ______ him that he never got an apology.
sentences.zh: 他始終沒有得到一句道歉,這件事仍然讓他耿耿於懷。

words.defn_en: the state of being annoyed or frustrated:
words.root_note: vexatio, from Latin vexare (to shake, disturb)

sentences.en: Her constant interruptions were a source of great ______ for the speaker.
sentences.zh: 她不斷的打斷讓這位講者感到極大的惱怒。

sentences.en: He sighed with ______ after the third delayed flight.
sentences.zh: 他在第三次班機延誤後,無奈地嘆了一口氣。

words.defn_en: annoying:

sentences.en: The neighbor's constant complaints became a ______ problem for the whole building.
sentences.zh: 鄰居不斷的抱怨成為整棟大樓令人煩惱的問題。

sentences.en: The lawsuit was dismissed as a ______ attempt to waste the court's time.
sentences.zh: 這起訴訟因被視為浪費法庭時間的煩人行為而遭駁回。

words.defn_en: annoyed or frustrated; difficult to resolve:

sentences.en: She looked ______ after being put on hold for an hour.
sentences.zh: 她被電話轉接等待了一個小時之後,看起來相當惱怒。

sentences.en: The committee tackled the ______ question of funding allocation.
sentences.zh: 這個委員會著手處理這個關於資金分配、棘手的問題。

words.defn_en: by way of; passing through:

sentences.en: They traveled to Rome ______ Paris to save on airfare.
sentences.zh: 他們經由巴黎前往羅馬,以節省機票費用。

sentences.en: The message was delivered ______ email rather than by mail.
sentences.zh: 這則訊息是透過電子郵件而非郵寄送達的。

words.defn_en: practicable, workable:

sentences.en: The startup needed a ______ business plan before investors would consider funding it.
sentences.zh: 這家新創公司需要一份切實可行的商業計畫,投資人才會考慮出資。

sentences.en: Doctors said the premature baby was ______ and would likely survive.
sentences.zh: 醫生表示這名早產兒具有存活能力,很可能能夠存活下來。

words.defn_en: lively; full of vitality

sentences.en: The city's ______ nightlife attracts visitors from around the world.
sentences.zh: 這座城市充滿活力的夜生活吸引了世界各地的遊客。

sentences.en: Her paintings are known for their ______ colors and bold strokes.
sentences.zh: 她的畫作以充滿活力的色彩與大膽的筆觸而聞名。

words.defn_en: a member of the clergy, especially in the Church of England:
words.root_note: vicarius (substitute, deputy), from Latin vicis (change, substitution)

sentences.en: The village ______ delivered a moving sermon on forgiveness.
sentences.zh: 這座村莊的教區牧師發表了一篇感人的關於寬恕的講道。

sentences.en: Parishioners gathered to welcome the newly appointed ______ .
sentences.zh: 教區居民聚集在一起,歡迎這位新任命的教區牧師。

words.defn_en: experiencing through another:

sentences.en: She felt a ______ thrill watching her daughter perform on stage for the first time.
sentences.zh: 看著女兒第一次登台表演,她感受到一股替代性的興奮喜悅。

sentences.en: He lived ______ly through his son's athletic achievements.
sentences.zh: 他透過兒子的運動成就間接體驗著自己未曾實現的夢想。

words.defn_en: deliberately cruel or violent:
words.root_note: vitiosus (faulty, corrupt), from Latin vitium (fault, vice)

sentences.en: The dog was labeled ______ after several unprovoked attacks.
sentences.zh: 這隻狗在數次無端攻擊事件後被貼上了凶惡的標籤。

sentences.en: She endured a ______ smear campaign during the election.
sentences.zh: 她在這場選舉中承受了一場惡毒的抹黑行動。

words.defn_en: event that occurs by chance:

sentences.en: Despite the many ______s of her career, she never lost her passion for teaching.
sentences.zh: 儘管她的職涯經歷了許多起伏變遷,她對教學的熱情從未消退。

sentences.en: The novel follows a family through the ______s of war and peace.
sentences.zh: 這部小說描述一個家庭經歷戰爭與和平交替變遷的故事。

words.defn_en: difficulties:

sentences.en: Through all the ______ of life, the two friends remained loyal to each other.
sentences.zh: 歷經人生種種變遷,這兩位朋友始終對彼此忠誠。

sentences.en: The company survived decades of economic ______ to become an industry leader.
sentences.zh: 這家公司歷經數十年的經濟興衰,終於成為業界領導者。

words.defn_en: extremely unpleasant or morally wrong:

sentences.en: The crime was condemned as a ______ act of cruelty.
sentences.zh: 這起犯罪被譴責為一項殘忍卑鄙的行為。

sentences.en: A ______ smell filled the abandoned warehouse.
sentences.zh: 一股令人作嘔的惡臭瀰漫在這座廢棄的倉庫中。

words.defn_en: the quality of being morally repugnant or extremely unpleasant:

sentences.en: The documentary exposed the ______ of the trafficking operation.
sentences.zh: 這部紀錄片揭露了這項人口販運行動的卑鄙邪惡。

sentences.en: Readers were shocked by the ______ of the villain's actions.
sentences.zh: 讀者對這名反派角色行為的邪惡感到震驚。

words.defn_en: to malign, slander:

sentences.en: The tabloids continued to ______ the actress long after the scandal ended.
sentences.zh: 醜聞平息許久之後,這些八卦小報仍持續詆毀這位女演員。

sentences.en: He was unfairly ______ied in the press for a decision he never made.
sentences.zh: 他因一項自己從未做過的決定,而在媒體上遭到不公平的詆毀。

words.defn_en: a wicked or evil person, especially in a story:
words.root_note: villanus (farmhand), from Medieval Latin villa (country house), meaning shifted over time

sentences.en: The movie's ______ plots to take over the entire city.
sentences.zh: 這部電影的反派密謀要接管整座城市。

sentences.en: Historians debate whether he was truly the ______ he was made out to be.
sentences.zh: 歷史學家爭論他是否真的如世人所描繪的那樣是個惡棍。

words.defn_en: characteristic of a villain; wicked:
words.root_note: villanus (farmhand), from Medieval Latin villa (country house), meaning shifted over time

sentences.en: The actor was praised for his ______ performance as the crime boss.
sentences.zh: 這位演員因飾演這位黑幫老大邪惡的表演而受到讚揚。

sentences.en: Their ______ scheme was foiled at the last possible moment.
sentences.zh: 他們這項邪惡的計謀在最後一刻被挫敗了。

words.defn_en: wicked or criminal behavior:

sentences.en: The novel exposes the depths of the count's ______ .
sentences.zh: 這本小說揭露了這位伯爵邪惡行徑的深度。

sentences.en: The town had long suffered under the ______ of the corrupt sheriff.
sentences.zh: 這座小鎮長期以來一直深受這位貪腐警長的罪行之苦。

words.defn_en: to absolve, justify:

sentences.en: New evidence eventually ______d him of the crime.
sentences.zh: 新證據最終證明了他的清白。

sentences.en: Her decision to leave the company was ______d when it went bankrupt.
sentences.zh: 當這家公司破產時,她離職的決定得到了證明是對的。

words.defn_en: the clearing of someone from blame or suspicion:
words.root_note: vindicatio, from Latin vindicare (to claim, avenge)

sentences.en: The new evidence provided complete ______ for the wrongly accused man.
sentences.zh: 這項新證據為這位遭到冤枉的男子帶來了徹底的平反。

sentences.en: Her promotion felt like a long-awaited ______ after years of being overlooked.
sentences.zh: 在多年被忽視之後,她的升遷感覺就像是一場期待已久的平反。

words.defn_en: vengeful:

sentences.en: Her ______ ex-partner spread false rumors after their breakup.
sentences.zh: 她那報復心強的前任在分手後散播了不實的謠言。

sentences.en: The manager was known for being ______ toward anyone who challenged his decisions.
sentences.zh: 這位經理以對任何挑戰他決定的人懷恨報復而聞名。

words.defn_en: a noisy or scolding or domineering woman:

sentences.en: The play portrays the queen as a fearsome ______ who terrifies her court.
sentences.zh: 這齣戲劇將女王描繪成一位讓宮廷聞風喪膽的悍婦。

sentences.en: The neighbors avoided the ______ next door, who shouted at anyone who walked too close.
sentences.zh: 鄰居們都盡量避開隔壁那位悍婦,她會對任何走得太近的人大聲咆哮。

words.defn_en: masterful, manly:

sentences.en: The advertisement portrayed the actor as young and ______.
sentences.zh: 這則廣告將這位演員塑造成年輕又充滿男子氣概的形象。

sentences.en: He was known for his ______ energy on the football field.
sentences.zh: 他以在足球場上展現的強健活力而聞名。

words.defn_en: behavior showing high moral standards; a good quality:

sentences.en: Patience is considered a ______ in nearly every culture.
sentences.zh: 耐心幾乎在每一種文化中都被視為一種美德。

sentences.en: Her greatest ______ was her unwavering honesty with everyone she met.
sentences.zh: 她最大的優點就是對每一個遇到的人都保持著堅定不移的誠實。
